target.description: Bare id, meaning fixed by `kind`, checked in this precedence order: playbook_slug set -> open_playbook, target the playbook slug (checked FIRST, even for an AUX-finding-derived task that also carries a finding or displacement id); else source_displacement_id set -> diagnose, target displacements.id; else source_finding_id set -> copy_patch, target aux_findings.id; else open_task, target tasks.id. Never a URL or patch text.
